title: Design System: 城市印记 · City Stamp

display.purpose: Large hero and section headlines; dense, high-contrast Chinese-led composition.

label.purpose: Serials, city codes, counts, timestamps, and small status labels.

shadows.name: badge-rest
shadows.purpose: Soft ambient depth under resting hexagonal badges.

shadows.name: badge-glow
shadows.purpose: State glow for an unlocked badge.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Separate the temporary check-in confirmation from the archive surface.

motion.name: glass-glare-tilt
motion.purpose: Responsive hover depth: the badge tilts toward the pointer while artwork and specular glare translate inversely like refracted glass.

motion.name: unlock-burst
motion.purpose: Single authored unlock moment: scale, saturation, flare, and glow.

components.name: Primary Text Action
components.description: A quiet gold-underlined action for beginning the collection.
components.css: .ds-text-action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; color:#f2d2a0; padding-bottom:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #c9a87a; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:.06em; transition:gap 180ms ease,color 180ms ease; } .ds-text-action:hover { gap:11px; color:#fff3de; } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2d2a0; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: A compact rounded filter that exposes its count.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { min-height:31px; padding:0 11px; border:1px solid rgba(202,169,124,.2); border-radius:100px; color:#a99d8e; background:transparent; font-size:11px; transition:color 180ms ease,border-color 180ms ease,background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-filter-chip span { margin-left:3px; color:#c9a87a; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:9px; } .ds-filter-chip:hover,.ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { border-color:#c9a87a; color:#f3eadb; background:rgba(202,169,124,.08); }

components.name: Archive Status Card
components.description: A framed summary of personal completion by city.
components.html:
ARCHIVE STATUS03

你的城市档案
components.css: .ds-archive-card { border:1px solid rgba(202,169,124,.54); background:#101415; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 5px #101415,inset 0 0 0 6px rgba(202,169,124,.17); padding:25px 24px 22px; } .ds-archive-label { color:#766d62; font:10px/1.4 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.12em; } .ds-archive-number { display:block; margin-top:26px; color:#f2d2a0; font-size:65px; font-weight:520; letter-spacing:-.1em; line-height:.8; } .ds-archive-card h3 { margin:24px 0 7px; color:#f3eadb; font-size:18px; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Hexagonal Landmark Badge
components.description: The core collectible: a six-sided archive mark with a translucent glass core, artwork bleed, pointer-driven tilt/glare, and a grayscale-to-city-accent check-in state.
components.css: .ds-badge-hit { border:0; padding:0; background:transparent; } .ds-hex-badge { --hex-ratio:.8660254; display:block; position:relative; aspect-ratio:var(--hex-ratio); background:#df705d; clip-path:polygon(50% 0,100% 25%,100% 75%,50% 100%,0 75%,0 25%); filter:drop-shadow(0 0 11px rgba(223,112,93,.43)) drop-shadow(0 12px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.34)); } .ds-hex-core { position:absolute; top:50%; left:50%; width:calc(100% - 28px); aspect-ratio:var(--hex-ratio); transform:translate(-50%,-50%); display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:20px; background:#141919; color:#f3eadb; clip-path:polygon(50% 0,100% 25%,100% 75%,50% 100%,0 75%,0 25%); } .ds-badge-art { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; filter:grayscale(1) contrast(.86) brightness(1.1) opacity(.7); } .ds-hex-status,.ds-hex-serial { color:#ffb29a; font:8px/1.4 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.12em; } .ds-badge-hit:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2d2a0; outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview:
城市印记把黑色档案纸、旧金细线、透明地标插画和六边形徽章组合成一张可操作的城市海报。页面的装饰不是独立的皮肤：每一条序号、每一座城市的色彩、每一枚徽章的图像，都在说明访客走过了什么。

界面在未打卡时保持克制的灰阶，只有真实的状态变化才释放城市色彩与光。页面不依赖账户、地图或定位权限，先让一个人的到访顺序拥有清晰、可回看的形状。
keyCharacteristics: 炭黑档案底与旧金细线
城市色彩只在身份和解锁状态中出现
六边形徽章作为核心内容对象
玻璃高光倾斜与反向视差
六边形打卡墙与可放大详情

rules.name: The Archive Frame Rule
rules.body: Major sections sit between hairline rules and the double page frame so the page reads like one continuous archive sheet.

rules.name: The State Is The Color Rule
rules.body: Keep an undiscovered badge in charcoal grayscale; spend coral, jade, or amber on the city identity and unlocked state.

rules.name: The One Unlock Moment Rule
rules.body: Use one authored burst for check-in: scale, saturation, edge flare, glow, and a time-confirming toast; respect reduced motion.

rules.name: The Glass Refraction Rule
rules.body: Keep tilt, artwork parallax, and sheen as one pointer-driven material response; reset smoothly on leave and suppress it for reduced motion.

dos: Do use one generated transparent landmark artwork per badge.
Do keep serials, counts, and timestamps in the mono label voice.
Do preserve the regular hexagonal silhouette across desktop and mobile.
Do let checked-in badges touch and overlap in the wall mosaic.
donts: Don't turn the archive into a generic rounded card dashboard.
Don't use accent color as decoration on locked content.
Don't remove the text timestamp or focus state when simplifying the visual treatment.
